explanation: Pole N541+ fires on grammatical/functional material rather than lexical heads: predicted active are determiners and articles (the, a, an, my, its, uma, una, los, Les, i, een, deze, hun), degree adverbs (nearly, completely, rather, extraordinarily) and copula 'be' (is, are, be, been, was, sono, sont, è), while English content-word heads (nouns, lexical verbs) are predicted inactive at ~0, as are English conjunctions, prepositions, infinitival 'to' and modals (has, will, would, may, can). Activation is far stronger in non-English European text, where the same grammatical material is tokenised separately and the word-final, inflection-bearing sub-token of a word also fires (-ende, -ische, -igen, -ßen, -ую, -ción, -mente).
